children: Overview
Italy food and beverage group's nine-month revenue rose 135% yr/yr, driven by acquisitions
Company posted net loss due to higher energy and transport costs; underlying net profit positive
EBITDA for the period rose nearly 68% yr/yr; full-year guidance confirmed
Outlook
2026 guidance confirmed: EBITDA expected between EUR 330 mln and EUR 350 mln
Company says strong recovery already under way in Q4, in line with expectations
Company expects incremental revenue of about EUR 150 mln from tomato processing in 2027
Result Drivers
ACQUISITIONS - Revenue growth driven by acquisitions, especially GS and Princes Ready to Drink
HIGHER ENERGY AND TRANSPORT COSTS - Net result impacted by approximately EUR 19 mln of higher energy and transport costs in Q3
GROSS MARGIN IMPROVEMENT - Gross margin rose from 19.8% to 21.6% due to initial integration and supply-chain synergies
